_meta: F5 — curated catalogue of community check / signature / payload drop-ins for WPSecScan. Hosted as static JSON in the repo; the marketplace browser GUI lists them, the user copies the download URL and pastes the file into ~/.wpsecscan/{signatures,payloads,plugins}/. Online distribution is intentionally manual so the user always inspects what they install.

entries.name: OWASP Top-10 2025 payload pack
entries.author: OWASP community
entries.summary: Refreshed payloads for SQLi / XSS / SSTI / SSRF tracking 2025-era WAF bypasses.

entries.name: Patchstack monthly CVE pack
entries.author: Patchstack
entries.summary: Monthly WordPress plugin/theme CVE signature snapshot — drop the JSON in to get the latest without `--update-db`.

entries.name: WooCommerce hardening pack
entries.author: WPSecScan core team
entries.summary: Drop-in checks for WC REST coupon abuse, guest checkout PII leakage, and stripe-test-mode-in-production.

entries.name: Elementor known-bad-config pack
entries.author: WPSecScan community
entries.summary: Catches the most common Elementor / Elementor Pro misconfigurations seen in pentest engagements.

entries.name: WP REST API authentication-bypass pack
entries.author: WPSecScan community
entries.summary: Active probes for known authn-bypass paths in the WP core REST + 8 popular custom-endpoint plugins.

entries.name: Geo-blocking validation payloads
entries.author: WPSecScan community
entries.summary: Set of X-Forwarded-For + CF-Connecting-IP values from 12 regions to validate geo-blocking rules.
